Senses.Explanation: The pivot that stamps the day at hand as the one point where the question lands — between two buddhas, or at the hinge of an occasion. Muchen Daomin, holding the unrestricted Avatamsaka assembly, sets the squeeze: Sakya has passed, Maitreya is yet to come — right this very day, who rules as lord inside the flower-treasury world? Zhe'an Jingfan works the same formula free of longing: Sakya gone, why chase the past; Maitreya unbuilt, why yearn ahead — right this very day, you with wits, breed no stray doubt, for the doubtless one is the hero. Yuanjie Jingying turns his own birthday: forty-four years before he dwelt in the past, after in the present — right this very day sage and ordinary interlace, host and guest converge, and no mark of same or different can be found; Chulin Shangrui rides the counting-nines rhyme over the ice to the enlightenment-day feast and asks what the feast is now — old Sakya's whole affair gone flat; Koho Kennichi, mid-summer, splits the season — first half an arrow off the string, second half a long sword propped on heaven — and right this very day asks who tops the school's measure; Guantao Daqi hands the new abbot the enthronement knife: right this very day the lives of all buddhas past and the founding teachers rest in the new elder's hand — release or hold, no one else decides; Yuan'an Liao at the winter release asks why the ninety days leaked no water, and what great gate swings wide right this very day; and Yushan Shangsi, at the requiem for a slaughtered-life karma, asks where the father is born — right this very day, what land after all?
